prompt: An increasing number of students choose to complete their university degree in a foreign country rather than at home. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of this trend.
essay:
These days, more and more students are going to the foreign countries for completing their university degree instead of studying in their own country. There are some advantages and also some disadvantages of this trend, and I will discuss both of them in this essay.

Firstly, let me discuss about the advantages. The main advantage is that the students can get the better education, because the universities in the developed countries have the modern facilities and the good teachers. Furthermore, they can improve their English language, which is very useful for their future career. In addition, living in a new country is a good experience for the young people because they can learn about the different cultures and they become more independent. Also, a foreign degree looks very good in the CV, so the companies will prefer them.

However, there are some disadvantages also. The biggest disadvantage is the money, because studying abroad is very expensive and not every family can afford it. The tuition fee, the accommodation and the flight tickets cost a lot. Another disadvantage is that many students feel lonely when they are far from their family and friends, and sometimes they get the culture shock. Also some students do not come back to their home country after the graduation, so their country lose the talented people.

In conclusion, studying in a foreign country has many advantages such as the better education and the language, but it also has the disadvantages like the high cost and the loneliness. In my opinion, students should consider all these things before taking the decision.
title: Taking a degree in another country
